node.title: XR SL-2 active-defect primitive Pade-list census
node.statement: At every prize-row depth ceil((2h+2)/3)<=d<=h-2 with rank J_d<2d, let D be the support of the invariant primitive residual rho=P(u-f)+Q(v-g), with e=|D|>=2(h-d) and e<=|G_d|<=d-ell-1. Let R_d^D be the maximal selected post-strip pairs for which every selected off-core block lies in D. The proved routers write each pair uniquely as (f0+Q tau,g0-P tau), deg tau<k-ell, and embed tau into an exact punctured RS list at agreement k+d on H\D. Every selected slope contributes a disjoint (h-d)-block in D and forces the outside roots of its degree-ell scalar factor into the core. Then 25|R_d^D|<=17n^2-25(n-e). The claim is proved for affine parameter dimensions through 10,10,9 by the low-span and mixed core/block payments; any counterexample has dimension at least 11,11,10. At those next dimensions, the affine-plane component payment closes every r>2ell tuple with d+ell<=6840580025 at rates 1/4,1/8 and d+ell<=3435973837 at rate 1/16. The common-ray eliminant bounds a fixed full-affine tuple by s+1 owners and extends the ell=1 slices through d+1=8500560263 at rates 1/4,1/8 and d+1=4265559234 at rate 1/16. Its uniform higher-ell comparison pays d+11ell-10<=8500560263 at rates 1/4,1/8 and d+10ell-9<=4265559234 at rate 1/16. The exact phi-fiber router sharpens every tuple order to the packed elementary-symmetric count and identifies the complementary endpoint: at least two disjoint selected block locators, each dividing one or two members of the primitive pencil bP-aQ. The residual high-fiber tails outside the envelope and this split-pencil locator census remain open. Maximality, first-match liveness, active-defect locality, and strip ownership remain load-bearing.
